cause: User-controlled input from fgets (up to 100 chars after length check at 0x40134a) is copied via __strcpy_chk into a 16-byte stack buffer (local_10 at rsp), with only the destlen=0x10 runtime guard; additionally __snprintf_chk is called with an incorrect buffer size (0xa0 vs actual 16 bytes), bypassing FORTIFY_SOURCE protections.
